data.spiritual_meaning: Eero expresses “Man, warrior”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Eero total 25, reducing to 7. Number 7 is associated with reflection, analysis and inner search.

in_greek.name: Εἴρω
in_greek.meaning: Εἴρω ἄνθρωπος με πλούσιο ἡρωικό πνεῦμα
in_greek.long_meaning: Εἴρω ἄνθρωπος με πλούσιο ἡρωικό πνεῦμα καὶ ἰσότιμη ἐξουσία, ὡς ἡρωίδα τοῦ Ἰσραήλ, με τὴν ἀρετή καὶ τὴν σοφία, ἔνταξη στὴν Ἐκκλησία, καὶ ἀποστολὴ εἰς τὴν ἄκρα

in_latin.name: Eero
in_latin.meaning: Vir fortis, vir magnus, vir virtutis
in_latin.long_meaning: Vir fortis, vir magnus, vir virtutis, qui habet virtutem et sapientiam, qui est fortis et magnus, qui habet potestatem et glorian, qui est vir egregius et nobilis
